properties.name: app.security.pepper
properties.description: Pepper for the password hashing. This should be a long, random string that is kept secret and not stored in the database.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: The secret key used to sign the JWT tokens.

properties.name: app.jwt.ttl-seconds
properties.description: The time-to-live for the JWT tokens, in seconds.

properties.name: app.cookie.name
properties.description: The name of the cookie used to store the JWT token.

properties.name: app.cookie.secure
properties.description: Defines if the cookie should be marked as secure, meaning it will only be sent over HTTPS connections.

properties.name: app.cookie.same-site
properties.description: Defines the SameSite attribute for the cookie, which can be 'Strict', 'Lax', or 'None'. This controls whether the cookie is sent with cross-site requests.

properties.name: app.cookie.max-age-seconds
properties.description: The maximum age of the cookie, in seconds.

properties.name: app.url.backend
properties.description: The base URL for the backend API.

properties.name: app.uploads.dir
properties.description: The directory where uploaded files are stored.

properties.name: app.uploads.url-path
properties.description: The URL path prefix for accessing uploaded files.

properties.name: app.url.frontend
properties.description: The base URL for the frontend application.
